descriptions.Full Song: A complete song recording with lead vocals and instrumental accompaniment.
descriptions.Song Demo: A song demo excerpt presenting a musical idea. This is a partial draft rather than a finished full song.
descriptions.Voice: An isolated singing vocal recording without intentional instrumental accompaniment. Separation artifacts may remain if extracted from a full mix.
descriptions.Instrument Stem: An isolated instrumental part from a recording.
descriptions.Loop: A short musical passage prepared for repeated looping.
descriptions.Field Recording / Ambience: A field recording or ambient sound recording.
